mission_10: Magnificent! You have built a production-grade automated outlier detection pipeline that combines multiple algorithms into a robust ensemble system. By integrating Isolation Forest, LOF, and Z-score detection with majority voting, your pipeline leverages the complementary strengths of each method while reducing false positives. Robust scaling ensures fair treatment of all features, and the severity scoring system provides actionable prioritization of detected anomalies. The automated report generation transforms raw detection results into interpretable insights. This pipeline architecture is directly applicable to real-world production systems, from fraud detection and network security to quality control and health monitoring. You have now mastered the full spectrum of outlier detection, from simple statistical methods to sophisticated ensemble pipelines!
